title: World English Bible — Apocrypha/Deuterocanon (1 Esdras 2:16–30)

verification_log.method: 2:16–29: Rathumus and Samellius write to "King Artaxerxes" that the Jews are building the city, its walls and "laying the foundation of a temple"; the king forbids the city's building; 2:30: the building of the Temple ceased "until the second year of the reign of King Darius" — the letter is placed before Darius

access_notes: Greek parallel to Ezra 4:7–24; quoted only briefly.
